listingDiscovery.name: MLS-syndicated portals
listingDiscovery.purpose: Discover and cross-check active, coming-soon, price-change, contingent, and back-on-market listings.

listingDiscovery.name: Public brokerage and IDX pages
listingDiscovery.purpose: Catch listings or new-construction inventory that may be indexed differently from national portals. Treat duplicate MLS numbers as one property.

listingDiscovery.name: Government and GSE inventory
listingDiscovery.purpose: Find REO inventory that may not surface promptly in general portal searches. Investor First Look restrictions must be checked.

listingDiscovery.name: Non-MLS and distressed inventory
listingDiscovery.purpose: Identify credible owner-listed or distressed opportunities. Auction and redemption risks prevent automatic recommendation.

listingDiscovery.name: Public auction and new-construction inventory
listingDiscovery.purpose: Find publicly marketed auction, bank-owned, and builder inventory. Financing, buyer eligibility, title, completion, and auction terms must be verified.

listingDiscovery.name: Credentialed listing feeds
listingDiscovery.purpose: Known coverage limitation. The family will not obtain third-party credentials or paid API keys, so the workflow must continue using public sources without treating this category as a failed run.

propertyVerification.name: Current marketing status and transfer chronology
sources: A second current MLS-syndicated or public IDX source
York County deed or transfer history where available
propertyVerification.purpose: Distinguish an active, pending, or contingent current listing from an earlier sale. A property page, contact form, or old listing alone is not evidence that a home is currently for sale. Reconcile the most recent transfer with every later list, relist, price-change, contract, and removal event; use the stricter current status when credible sources conflict.

propertyVerification.name: Parcel, assessment, and deed
propertyVerification.purpose: Confirm parcel identity, ownership, transfers, recorded plats, liens or pending actions, assessment, and tax district.

propertyVerification.name: Permits, zoning, and rental legality
sources: Rock Hill zoning and rental registration
York County zoning map and code
propertyVerification.purpose: Check permit history, legal bedroom count, zoning, occupancy, and the proposed unrelated-roommate arrangement.

propertyVerification.name: Flood and physical risk
propertyVerification.purpose: Flag mapped flood zone and identify insurance or drainage follow-up. This does not replace inspection or an insurance quote.

propertyVerification.name: HOA governing documents
propertyVerification.purpose: Determine whole-unit and individual-room rental authority. Portal statements and silence are not evidence of permission.

rentEvidence.name: Private-unit rent
rentEvidence.purpose: Establish current studio and one-bedroom asking-rent range.

rentEvidence.name: Individual-room rent
rentEvidence.purpose: Estimate room rent by private-bath status, furnishing, lease length, and utilities.
